App details

Ruler & Protractor

Measure small objects and angles with a calibrated ruler and protractor on your screen.

In the worksPlannedAndroid

What it’s for

A calibrated on-screen ruler with metric and imperial scales, plus 0–180° and 0–360° protractor modes for short objects and angles.

Main features

  • Metric and imperial ruler scales.
  • Move markers to measure between two points.
  • Protractor modes from 0–180° and 0–360°.
  • Calibrate against a known length.

This app is being planned and is not yet available to download. The description presents its intended functions.

Features in detail

Measure lengths and angles on the screen

Screen-edge ruler and two markers

Place a short object along the calibrated screen edge. Choose mm/cm, inches or both, and move markers A and B to its ends. Read their positions and the distance between them. Only length that physically fits on the screen is shown; a larger tablet gives more measuring space.

Calibrate, save, check and reset

Adjust the displayed scale to a known physical reference length and confirm before saving. Use Calibration Check to compare it again or Reset Calibration to return to the device baseline. Calibration belongs to that device; screen specifications alone do not guarantee an accurate physical ruler.

Starting margin and temporary zero

Shift the temporary measuring zero or starting margin to account for a case, curved screen edge or obstructed beginning. Lock the margin to prevent accidental movement and reset it separately. This moves the starting point while keeping the calibrated scale unchanged.

180° and 360° protractors

Choose the semicircle or full-circle view and align the two independently movable arms with the angle’s sides. Read the angle between them numerically. Optional angle snap helps position an arm at marked angles and can be switched off.

Magnifier, locks and screen control

A magnified view helps position a marker or angle arm hidden under your finger. Lock markers or arms for safe reading, then unlock explicitly. Portrait/landscape, optional screen-awake and short snap/lock vibration help during use. No camera is needed; measurements stay offline.

Just one more centimetre

Tap the About logo seven times: a playful ruler reaches the screen edge and keeps stretching to fit extra centimetres. Close this offline scene to return. It does not extend the real measuring range or change calibration.

Use, settings and availability

Offline use

The main functions are designed to work on your device without a JN86 account. Ads, purchases and external links may need internet.

Language, settings and help

Choose one of eight app languages and adjust the available settings. About provides privacy information and a link to voluntary JN86 support. Support does not unlock paid functions. Availability is shown below.

Ads and optional ad removal

All described functions are planned to be free, with banner ads and optional one-time Google Play ad removal. No subscription is planned. The purchase screen shows the actual local price; purchase restoration uses Google Play.

Availability

This app is being created. The features described here are planned; it is not yet available to download.
